description: This file defines the NvramConfig class and its nested InstanceSpecific class, managing configuration data for a modem simulator, including initialization, accessors, and file operations.

classes.name: NvramConfig
classes.description: Holds the configuration data for the modem simulator, providing methods to initialize, retrieve, modify, and save configuration instances.

classes.name: NvramConfig::InstanceSpecific
classes.description: Represents configuration details specific to an individual modem simulator instance, including network mode, operator, technology, and emergency status.

methods.name: InitNvramConfigService
methods.description: Static method to initialize the NVRAM configuration service with a specified number of instances and simulation type.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieve the current NvramConfig instance.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Save the current configuration to the default file location.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Save the current configuration object to a specified filename.

methods.name: ConfigFileLocation
methods.description: Get the default file location for the configuration.

methods.name: ForInstance
methods.description: Get the configuration for a specific instance number.

methods.name: Instances
methods.description: Get a list of all instance-specific configurations.

methods.name: sim_type
methods.description: Retrieve the simulation type.

methods.description: Constructor for creating an instance-specific configuration scope.
